svg.desc: OpenBridge Pump (OpenBridge obc-pump, Apache-2.0). Bindable properties: _pb_running (default false): Running feedback _pb_vertical (default false): Vertical orientation _pb_alarm (default false): Alarm active (red alert frame) _pb_auto (default false): Auto mode badge _ps_tag (default ''): Numeric equipment ID shown as #NNNN (empty = hidden) _pb_command (default false): Start/stop command: written with !running on click
